# Reviewed prerelease dependency

`ifsoul-core-0.2.0-alpha.1.tgz` is the public Core package built from the sibling
Core extraction of the reviewed `70680d5` source baseline. It contains only public
runtime, protocol, memory and model-provider files and license metadata. The
archive is intentionally committed for standalone clean-checkout installation;
it contains no private cloud code or user data. npm publishing is not configured.

Final source commit: `1dd6f800117c9be215e76553198e74e2db404be0`.
SHA-256: `ab3b1419cd7097df2d08599e22d5bab4d93e2c50c9227a179d529985e5e1efc3`.
The test gate verifies the receipt and rejects local/private archive members.
